SELECT `id`, `userId`, `title`, `location`,
ST_Y(locationpoint) AS `longitude`, ST_X(locationpoint) AS `latitude`, `restLocation`, `expiredAt`, `contentText`, `afterMeetingContent`, `exerciseType`, `distance`, `speed`, `power`, `minHeadCount`, `maxHeadCount`, `isRestExist`, `isAbandonOkay`, `isAfterPartyExist`, `isLocationConnectedToKakao`, `isUserAbilityConnectedToStrava`, `isMyPaceShown`, `isMyFtpShown`, `currentStatus`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` FROM `meetingPost` ORDER BY `createdAt` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT `id`,
`title`, `location`, `expiredAt`, `exerciseType`, `distance`, `speed`, `power`, `minHeadCount`, `maxHeadCount`, `isRestExist`, `isAbandonOkay`, `createdAt` FROM `meetingPost` ORDER BY `createdAt` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT `id`, `userId`, `title`, `location`,
ST_Y(locationpoint) AS `longitude`, ST_X(locationpoint) AS `latitude`, `restLocation`, `expiredAt`, `contentText`, `afterMeetingContent`, `exerciseType`, `distance`, `speed`, `power`, `minHeadCount`, `maxHeadCount`, `isRestExist`, `isAbandonOkay`, `isAfterPartyExist`, `isLocationConnectedToKakao`, `isUserAbilityConnectedToStrava`, `isMyPaceShown`, `isMyFtpShown`, `currentStatus`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `duration`, `height` FROM `meetingPost` WHERE `id` = #{id}

SELECT `id` ,`userId` , ST_Y(`locationpoint`) AS `longitude` , ST_X(`locationpoint`) AS `latitude` ,`exerciseType` ,`speed` ,`power` FROM `meetingpost` WHERE MBRContains( ST_GeomFromText( CONCAT( 'POLYGON((', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLng}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{minLng}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{maxLng}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{maxLng}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLng}, '))' ),4326 ), `locationpoint` ) and `id` >= #{id}

SELECT `id` ,`userId` ,`power` ,`duration` ,`height` ,`expiredAt` ,`exerciseType` FROM `meetingpost` WHERE MBRContains( ST_GeomFromText( CONCAT( 'POLYGON((', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLng}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{minLng}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{maxLng}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{maxLng}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLng}, '))' ),4326 ), `locationpoint` )
SELECT `id` FROM `meetingpost` WHERE `createdAt` >= #{date} ORDER BY `id` ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT `id`, `title`, `location`, `expiredAt`, `exerciseType`, `distance`, `speed`, `power`, `minHeadCount`, `maxHeadCount`, `isRestExist`, `isAbandonOkay`, `createdAt` FROM `meetingpost` WHERE `userId` = #{userId} AND ( (`currentStatus` = 'BEFORE_MEETING' AND `expiredAt` < NOW()) OR (`currentStatus` = 'REPORT_MAKING') ) ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT `id`, `title`, `location`, `expiredAt`, `exerciseType`, `distance`, `speed`, `power`, `minHeadCount`, `maxHeadCount`, `isRestExist`, `isAbandonOkay`, `createdAt` FROM `meetingpost` WHERE `id` < #{startId} AND `currentStatus` = 'FINAL_REPORT' ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT #{batchSize}
SELECT `id` FROM `meetingpost` ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT `id` FROM `meetingpost` WHERE `userId` = #{userId} ORDER BY `id` DESC
LIMIT 10
